story: An icon of the skies, the Northern Carmine Bee Eater (Merops nubicus) is a species from the Meropidae family. It thrives in African savannah habitats; deserts; woodlands; river flood-plains; and open grasslands, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Northern Carmine Bee Eater is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Northern Carmine Bee Eater helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Northern Carmine Bee Eater, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
